title: RepoTrace: Browser-Assisted Evidence Collection for GitHub Research Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2607.05106v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Empirical software engineering studies frequently build datasets from GitHub issues and pull requests. In many projects, researchers inspect pages in a browser, copy selected fields into spreadsheets, keep side notes in separate documents, and later run scripts to normalize or export the data. This workflow is flexible, but the page evidence, the research codes, and the rationale behind each decision end up spread across tabs and files, which leaves provenance, update tracking, and multi-reviewer labeling hard to audit.   RepoTrace is a browser-assisted research tool that collects GitHub issue and pull-request evidence into a local SQLite-backed workspace. It combines a Chrome side-panel extension, an Express backend, and a React dashboard to capture page snapshots, comments, labels, notes, screening and labeling decisions, refresh history, and scoped exports, keeping the source evidence and the research interpretation linked togethe

translated_title: RepoTrace：面向GitHub研究数据集的浏览器辅助证据收集工具
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.05106v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：实证软件工程研究经常从GitHub问题和拉取请求中构建数据集。在许多项目中，研究人员在浏览器中检查页面，将选定字段复制到电子表格中，在单独文档中记录旁注，随后运行脚本以规范化或导出数据。这种工作流程灵活，但页面证据、研究代码以及每项决策背后的理由最终分散在多个标签页和文件中，导致溯源、更新跟踪和多审阅者标注难以审计。RepoTrace是一种浏览器辅助研究工具，将GitHub问题和拉取请求的证据收集到本地SQLite支持的工作区中。它结合了Chrome侧边栏扩展、Express后端和React仪表板，以捕获页面快照、评论、标签、笔记、筛选和标注决策、刷新历史以及范围化导出，从而将源证据与研究解释保持关联。
tldr: RepoTrace通过结合浏览器扩展和后端仪表板，将GitHub研究数据集的证据收集、标注和溯源整合到本地SQLite工作区，解决了传统工作流中证据分散和审计困难的问题。
en_tdlr: RepoTrace integrates evidence collection, labeling, and provenance for GitHub research datasets into a local SQLite workspace via a browser extension and dashboard, addressing the auditability issues caused by fragmented workflows.
